measures.title: Levy Lid Lift (Fire and Emergency Medical Services)
measures.what_it_does: Lifts Longview's regular property tax levy to hire firefighter paramedics/EMTs, replace aging equipment, buy a fire engine and build a third fire station; the 2027 levy becomes the base for future levy limits.
measures.cost_line: Raises the city's regular levy rate by $1.15 per $1,000 of assessed value beginning in 2027 (opponents: from $1.955 to $3.105).

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.
